IN DEVELOPMENT

PayWatch

From transaction streams to auditable fraud signals.

FOCUS & METHODS

Kafka / LSTM / FastAPI

View media gallery ↗

Problem & intended user

Help a fraud-monitoring team prioritize suspicious transactions and inspect scoring decisions.

Data & workflow

The planned pipeline combines Kafka ingestion, an LSTM autoencoder, XGBoost scoring, ONNX Runtime, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL logging.

Design decisions

Evaluate a two-stage scoring design to balance computational cost with the risk of missing fraudulent events during anomaly triage.

Evaluation approach

Measure fraud recall, precision, false negatives at the triage stage, end-to-end latency, and behavior under delayed or duplicate events.

Results & evidence

Latency and filtering targets are not reported as achieved results. Verified measurements are pending.

Limitations & next steps

Complete end-to-end validation, establish baselines, and document drift monitoring and failure recovery.
